reason: This plugin is primarily a memory/context utility for DeepSeek Harness agents, centered on persisting and retrieving knowledge entries across sessions. Evidence from the README and package metadata shows it exposes three dedicated tools for writing, searching, and refreshing recent memory with local FTS5-backed storage, with no explicit external service integration described.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化智能体记忆工具（kg_remember、kg_search、kg_recent），可在本地存储与检索会话间的经验和上下文。
summaries.en: This plugin adds persistent memory tools to DeepSeek Harness (kg_remember, kg_search, kg_recent) so agents can store and retrieve session context and notes from a local database.

capabilities: Persist notes/lessons/patterns/decisions across agent sessions in a local node:sqlite FTS5 database
Provide three model-facing tools: kg_remember, kg_search, and kg_recent
Support full-text recall and recent-context retrieval via search and ranking
Sanitize malformed search input and fall back to recent listing behavior
